literal: With grand festivals, daily worship will not happen, if the sky dries up, even for the heavenly beings, here.
translation: If the heavens dry up, neither grand festivals nor daily worship will be offered here in this world, even to the heavenly gods.
modern: வானம் மழை தராமல் வறண்டு போனால், இவ்வுலகில் தேவர்களுக்கும் கூடச் சிறப்பு வழிபாடுகளும் தினசரி பூசைகளும் நடைபெறாது.
explanation: This couplet highlights the absolute dependency of all religious rituals on rain. The author states that if the sky fails to pour rain, even the gods in heaven will not receive their grand festivals or daily offerings from the people on earth. The word 'வறக்குமேல்' combines 'வறக்கும்' (dries up) and 'ஏல்' (if) to set the condition of drought. The particle 'உம்' in 'வானோர்க்கும்' emphasizes that even the divine beings, who are otherwise exalted, lose their worship when the earth lacks water.
